author: Stephen Walsh
name: Clean Web API Template
description: An ASP.NET Core Web API with controllers on .NET 10, built with Clean Architecture minus the ceremony.

authorName.description: Who gets the credit in the Authors and Copyright of the Presentation project. Leave it and Stephen Walsh gets the credit, which he'd enjoy more than you would.

authority.description: The OAuth authorization server that issues access tokens. Leave it empty to run without authentication, which is fine on your machine and brave anywhere else.

audience.description: The audience access tokens must be issued for, usually the API's own URL. Not the people in the room, who are lovely but don't carry tokens.

skipRestore.description: Don't restore packages after the solution is created. Handy on a plane, offline, or when you like to do things yourself.

postActions.description: Restore the NuGet packages the solution needs, so the first build has less to do.

manualInstructions.text: Run 'dotnet restore'. It takes less time than reading this sentence twice.
